not_a_trial_freeze: Neither this config nor a fit artifact is a full trial freeze.

contract.hash_of: raw UTF-8 blob at the issuing commit

hash_conventions.raw: sha256 of the raw UTF-8 bytes of a file or text
hash_conventions.object: sha256 of json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8')
hash_conventions.artifact_identities: source_sha256 and config_sha256 are raw-byte hashes of this module and this config

cell_label: f'{int(has_payload_failure)}{int(has_incomplete)}'; ordered cells 00, 01, 10, 11 (worker reading of the contract's cell order)
map_class: all 16 deterministic maps from the four cells to the two actions
weights: w_gi = 1/(G*m_g) over all supplied development families and planned roots, including nonactionable roots
scores: L = observed successes / planned R; U = L + missing/R; common roots [y,y] if observed else [0,1]; exact Fractions
criterion: J(pi) = sum w_gi * L_gi,pi(state) plus identical common-root lower scores
b1_rule: RETHINK iff J(constant RETHINK) > J(constant PATCH), else PATCH (quality tie rule, not a cost claim)
d_rule: per cell, the strictly larger weighted lower sum; on equality or an unseen cell, b1; no minimum cell size, no tuning
limits: training optimality J(d) >= J(b1) is algebraic, not evidence of improvement, not an unbiased value estimate or confidence bound
